name: Calendar
description: Month grid for picking a single day, a date range or several days, with controlled month navigation.

props.name: mode
props.description: Selection mode: single picks one day, range a start/end pair, multiple several days. Required when the calendar tracks a selection. Example: mode="single"

props.name: selected
props.description: Controlled selection, matching the shape implied by mode. Example: selected={date}

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called with the new selection when the user picks a day. Example: onSelect={setDate}

props.name: month
props.description: Controlled month displayed in the grid. Example: month={new Date(2026, 0, 1)}

props.name: onMonthChange
props.description: Called when the user navigates to another month. Example: onMonthChange={setMonth}

props.name: defaultMonth
props.description: Month shown on first render when the month is uncontrolled. Example: defaultMonth={new Date()}

props.name: numberOfMonths
props.description: Number of months rendered side by side. Example: numberOfMonths={2}

props.name: showOutsideDays
props.description: Render the trailing and leading days that belong to the neighbouring months. Example: showOutsideDays={false}

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dates the user cannot select, for example weekends or dates before today. Example: disabled={{ before: new Date() }}

props.name: fromDate
props.description: Earliest selectable date. Example: fromDate={new Date(2026, 0, 1)}

props.name: toDate
props.description: Latest selectable date. Example: toDate={new Date(2026, 11, 31)}

props.name: hidden
props.description: Dates removed from the grid entirely. Example: hidden={{ dayOfWeek: [0, 6] }}

props.name: modifiers
props.description: Named date sets used for custom styling. Example: modifiers={{ booked: bookedDays }}

props.name: captionLayout
props.description: Caption style: a static label or month/year dropdowns. Example: captionLayout="dropdown"

props.name: weekStartsOn
props.description: Index of the first day of the week, 0 = Sunday. Example: weekStartsOn={1}

props.name: fixedWeeks
props.description: Always render six weeks so the calendar height never jumps. Example: fixedWeeks

props.name: locale
props.description: date-fns locale used for month and weekday names. Example: locale={vi}

props.name: today
props.description: Date treated as today, useful for deterministic tests. Example: today={new Date(2026, 0, 1)}

props.name: classNames
props.description: Per-element class overrides for the internal day-picker parts. Example: classNames={{ day: "rounded-md" }}

props.name: components
props.description: Replace internal parts such as the month chevrons. Example: components={{ Chevron: MyChevron }}

props.name: className
props.description: CSS class names for the calendar root. Example: className="p-3"
